svg.title: C8 公共调用、编译选择与输入输出布局
svg.desc: xs_c8_gemv_8x32 is a compile-time alias. XS_C8_GEMV_FORCE_RVV=0 or absent selects the VDot implementation; 1 selects RVV. packed_ax contains row-major signed INT8 A[8][32], 256 bytes, immediately followed by x[32], 32 bytes. output_slots contains eight 16-byte slots. Each complete 128-bit slot contains zero in bits 127:32 and the signed dot product in bits 31:0. Bit fields are drawn high-to-low, not as an endianness diagram. Both buffers are 16-byte aligned and non-overlapping. VLEN=128.
svg.text: S[i]：第 i 行点积补码
两缓冲区各自 16 B 对齐、互不重叠；VLEN = 128
